sentence_stem: What puzzled the committee most was
correct_completion: why the proposal had been rejected so quickly.
full_sentence: What puzzled the committee most was why the proposal had been rejected so quickly.
acceptable_variants: why the proposal was rejected without any explanation.
how the decision had been reached so quickly.

options.text: the proposal rejected without any explanation.
options.why_wrong: This is not a noun clause. It has no finite verb after the subject, so it cannot follow 'was' as the thing that puzzled the committee.

options.text: why the proposal had been rejected so quickly.
to see how the proposal would be treated.
options.why_wrong: An infinitive phrase expresses a purpose. It does not name the thing that puzzled the committee, which is the reason for the rejection.

options.text: the committee rejected the proposal without explanation.
options.why_wrong: A full main clause cannot follow 'was' directly. The complement must be a noun clause introduced by a wh-word or 'that'.

grammar_focus: Wh-noun clauses as the complement of 'was' in a pseudo-cleft sentence
explanation: After 'was' in this structure, the noun clause must be a complete clause introduced by a wh-word, so that it names the thing that puzzled the committee. Turkish speakers may find this hard because Turkish marks embedded clauses with nominalising suffixes at the end of the clause rather than with introducing words, so they may drop the wh-word or place the clause in the wrong position.
translation: Komitenin en çok şaşırdığı şey, teklifin neden bu kadar çabuk reddedildiğiydi.
